neighbour_check: No standalone spots, so no orphan within 40 km of a destination. Alternatives rejected: one Fleurieu Peninsula destination (about 70 km span, 55+ pins, swallows McLaren Vale and Victor Harbor, which are the names travellers use); Deep Creek National Park as a destination (only Blowhole Beach and the Wild South Coast Way of its own).
